storage: fresh physical table in the adapter database for each capture

parameters.DatabaseName: explicit source database; current helper database in the example
parameters.CheckDateOverride: explicit capture timestamp with UTC offset
parameters.remainingParameters: pinned upstream defaults; recorded selection-affecting values in CaptureManifest.Parameters

units.TotalCPU: milliseconds; upstream microseconds / 1000, then bigint truncation
units.AverageCPU: milliseconds; independently truncated source average, consistency check only
units.TotalDuration: milliseconds; upstream microseconds / 1000, then bigint truncation
units.PlanCreationTime: source server-local datetime; not converted to UTC or used for a common sample window
units.CheckDate: datetimeoffset; compared with explicit UTC capture metadata

stableOrder: TotalCPU descending, then source ID ascending within each completed capture
coverage: upstream CPU-selected statements from one database; upstream filtering/deduplication applies; not full server history
